answer: A payout is split and thus 23% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The juniper schedule is applied in cipher and vine shows each instalment. An copycat thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2982 identities would post 4799 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
